services.name: Charter Highlights
services.desc: Our boat can handle groups of 1 to 6 persons. Larger groups can be accommodated if you book in advance. Our season is May through October. Morning, afternoon, and full-day fishing charters are available. Captain Doug monitors the weather and will contact you if it is unsafe to be on the water. If a charter is cancelled due to weather, you may reschedule or have your deposit

blurb: Guests fish for Coho, Chinook, Atlantic Salmon, Rainbow, Brown, and Lake Trout on Lake Ontario. The boat accommodates 1 to 6 persons, with larger groups by advance booking. Charters are available morning, afternoon, or full day from May through October.
